chapter: Jazz opinions, Jelly Roll and the Rhythm Club
title: Muslims, drugs and Armstrong and cocaine
summary: He knew of no Muslim musicians or dope, only corn whiskey, and does not believe Armstrong used cocaine.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Were any of the musicians into the Muslim religion or Islamic religion?
Were any of the musicians in the Islamic thing or Muslims or anything like that in the 30's?
Never heard of anything like that? Were drugs a problem in the bands? Dope?
Never heard of that. I never heard of no dope.
Things like heroin and so forth like that? Everybody was drinking at the time?
Do you remember telling me about Louis Armstrong giving you a reefer once?
He was talking that way before you were born.
You told me Louis Armstrong gave you a joint, a reefer. He gave you some marijuana once.
Somebody also had mentioned to me one time about Louis Armstrong and cocaine.

I don't believe that. Of course the way Louis acted, I don't remember if he was high, so help me God, if he was ever high - I don't remember seeing him high and I've seen him smoke reefer. I never seen him high or get out of place, never.
But you never started using anything like cocaine or heroin?
I don't believe he ever did. I don't believe it, I don't care what nobody says.
